title: Kissed Citrusy Italian Zucchini Lasagna
description: A citrusy and indulgent Italian dish featuring zucchini and an egg wash, made Whole30-friendly by using compliant ingredients, and given a unique twist with an ice-bath-shock step to create a fluffy texture.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper to create the egg wash.
Dip each zucchini slice into the egg wash, coating both sides evenly.
Place the coated zucchini slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the zucchini slices and sprinkle with chopped basil.
Bake the zucchini slices in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
While the zucchini is baking, prepare the cashew cheese according to the package instructions.
Once the zucchini is done, remove it from the oven and immediately submerge it in an ice bath to stop the cooking process and create a fluffy texture.
To assemble the lasagna, create layers of zucchini slices, cashew cheese, and chopped basil in a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of cashew cheese on top.
